Auto Leveling System
An auto leveling function (static control), which adjusts the beam axis while the vehicle is stopped, has been provided for the low beam headlights of models with discharge headlights to prevent glare to oncoming and preceding vehicles.
The auto leveling system consists of the headlight leveling computer, height control sensor, headlight leveling actuators, etc.
Auto Leveling System Configuration
Components Main Functions
Headlight Leveling Computer Controls the auto leveling function. Determines the vehicle posture and driving condition based on signals from the height control sensor and combination meter, and controls the headlight leveling actuators. When a system malfunction is detected, outputs a headlight auto leveling warning indicator light illumination request signal to the combination meter.
Headlight Leveling Actuator Drives the low beam headlight up and down according to the control signal from the headlight leveling computer to control the direction of the beam axis.
Combination Meter Illuminates the headlight auto leveling warning indicator light according to the signal from the headlight leveling computer. Outputs the vehicle speed signal to the headlight leveling computer.
Height Control Sensor Detects the vehicle height and outputs a vehicle height change signal to the headlight leveling computer.
